TITLE: Status Report: Vendor Access and Renewal Oversight for Q2 FY28

Zastama Industries' oversight of vendor access and renewal is currently in a state of active review, particularly in relation to Radesan Consulting. As we approach Q2 FY28, the renewal status of this vendor remains under evaluation, with a focus on ensuring continued compliance and service reliability. The team, under the guidance of Gunpa Kemtois, Director of Engineering, is coordinating closely with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth transition or renewal process when the time arrives.

Progress to date includes the documentation of Radesan Consulting's current access privileges, which are managed under the badge series TY-9880-L. Audits conducted in the previous quarter have confirmed that all equipment deliveries to the Gahikron Campus have been consistent with contractual obligations and site requirements. Gunpa Kemtois has also initiated a cross-departmental review to reassess the criteria for vendor selection and retention, in light of upcoming renewal cycles.

Key risks currently under consideration include potential disruptions to the Gahikron Campus operations should Radesan Consulting's services be interrupted during the renewal process. Additionally, the timeline for finalizing the Q2 FY28 renewal is tight, and any delays could result in a gap in service or the need for a temporary vendor solution. These risks are being actively managed through regular coordination with the finance lead and internal operational teams, who are preparing for all contingency scenarios.

Next steps include finalizing the renewal criteria by the end of the current quarter, which will be informed by the ongoing review and input from relevant departments. Gunpa Kemtois will lead a series of internal discussions with the engineering and operations leads to align on final requirements for Radesan Consulting or any replacement vendor. Additionally, a formal review of the TY-9880-L access series will be conducted to ensure continued alignment with the security protocols at the Gahikron Campus. The renewal request for Radesan Consulting will be submitted ahead of the Q2 FY28 deadline, with a secondary plan in development in parallel to ensure operational continuity.

The continued coordination of these efforts will remain a priority for the oversight team, ensuring that Zastama Industries maintains its high standards of operational efficiency and vendor accountability.
